fields.mechanism: Lead conflict and lifetime consequences differ by TTVI modality
fields.intervention: Develop coronary stent with adaptive geometry that dynamically adjusts to vessel anatomy to minimize mechanical conflict
fields.expected_effect: Reduced stent-vessel wall interactions that cause recurring injury events without introducing new failure modes
fields.falsification_test: Computational modeling of adaptive stent deployment in various coronary anatomies, measuring mechanical stress points and potential for vessel damage compared to conventional stents
fields.mechanism_source_span: Lead conflict and lifetime consequences differ by TTVI modality: repair approaches are generally more lead-tolerant, whereas valve replacement creates obligate lead jailing with implications for lead performance, future extraction

fields.expected_effect: Reduced mechanical interference between stent and leads, preserving lead function and reducing TR risk
fields.falsification_test: In vitro testing of modular stent design with various lead configurations under simulated physiological conditions

fields.expected_effect: Reduced incidence of tissue damage and inflammation caused by stent-tissue interaction
fields.falsification_test: In vitro mechanical testing comparing standard stents versus marker-guided stents for tissue contact forces and damage

fields.mechanism: Lead conflict and lifetime consequences differ by intervention modality
fields.intervention: Develop a coronary stent with variable radial strength that can adapt to vessel wall characteristics to minimize mechanical stress points
fields.expected_effect: Reduce recurring vessel injury by distributing mechanical forces more evenly across the vessel wall
fields.falsification_test: In vitro fatigue testing comparing conventional stents with the adaptive radial strength stent under cyclic loading conditions
fields.mechanism_source_span: "Lead conflict and lifetime consequences differ by TTVI modality: repair approaches are generally more lead-tolerant, whereas valve replacement creates obligate lead jailing with implications for lead performance, future extraction"
